verdict.rationale: Opting out of AI-model training is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS that handles sensitive financial data, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI training on user data, opt-out controls, or data-use restrictions. The MCP server and agent use-case items concern AI integration, not training-data policy, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
